data.name: Siddhi
data.gender_notes: Siddhi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root sidh, 'to accomplish' — siddhi, 'accomplishment'. Its root is Sanskrit sidh (सिध्). A central concept in Hindu and yogic tradition. Siddhi is a Sanskrit name meaning “Accomplishment; perfection; attainment”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Siddhi expresses “Accomplishment; perfection; attainment”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root sidh, 'to accomplish' — siddhi, 'accomplishment'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Siddhi total 35, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
